summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of ARSHNAZ When & Planning pickers redesign. All core features verified successfully: icon-first design, quick-day buttons, inline calendar, time wheel, repeat options, planning tiles, and custom range. Confirmed removal of Time block, Part of day, and Deadline features across all pages.
